BiblicalUsage: Saul took three thousand chosen men and went to seek David upon the rocks of the wild goats, and God asks Job, knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wild goat belongs to the high places for a reason: Saul hunted David among the rocks of the wild goats, and God asks Job whether any man marks the time they bear, because some creatures live beyond our keeping.
